placements.why: The decision to adopt Zypherion as the analytics database is an architecture-level technology choice. No existing strata category covers this, so minting Architecture as a top-level organizational category for technology-stack decisions.
placements.title: Technology stack and infrastructure decisions
placements.theme: Choices about the systems and infrastructure that underpin the organization's products.

placements.title: Analytics pipeline migrates to Zypherion for columnar performance
placements.theme: The organization commits to replacing its current analytics database with Zypherion, motivated by 15x faster columnar queries, with migration beginning next quarter.
placements.why: All six segments cohere around a single technology adoption decision: the commitment (src-1, src-4), the performance justification (src-2, src-5), and the migration timeline (src-3, src-6). The 15x measurement is evidence for the adoption theme, not a separate leaf per the grain test. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as the migration progresses.
